runs.name: Table Trac, Inc.; OTCQX TBTC, Minnesota, 10-K filer; casino management and player-tracking systems (CasinoTrac) for small and tribal casinos, system sales plus maintenance
runs.box: TOO HARD (WORK) AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Run at the operator's request ("run a test through the BRK framework using TBTC"), interactive dispatch under the canonical brief, lock held by the main session; the brief's one departure is the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25 (C:\Projects\BRK). Price **$5.37** (2026-10-23, aggregator, flagged) x **4,642,887 shares** (one class, 10-Q cover `0001437749-26-027186`, checked against 4,756,734 issued less 113,847 treasury) = cap **$24.93M**; sovereign **5.33%** (Treasury 30-year, 2026-10-23). Q1 IN (maintenance revenue $1.69M in 2015 to $6.15M in 2025; in 2020 total revenue fell 44% and maintenance 8%, 10-K `0001437749-21-007795`). Q2 TOO HARD (WORK): the operator count has stood at 115 since FY2023 while about sixteen new customers were installed in 2024 and 2025, and maintenance revenue has been flat for six quarters ($1.51M to $1.58M); retention is knowable and not in the filings; nothing shows the castle open. Competitors (whole-company operating margin, whole span, XBRL transcription): TBTC 11.2% (2015 to 2025), LNW 6.8%, EVRI 11.4%, AGYS 0.2%, IGT 9.7% as filed; LNW's gaming systems revenue alone about 26 times TBTC's whole revenue (10-K `0000750004-26-000012`). COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash $1.443M a year maintenance only, $0.991M after all spending (2021 to 2025, before interest); range $7.21 to $7.57 a share all-equity at the halves-method growth (a CONVENTION of the run, confessed), fair price $4.63 all-equity ($3.35 equity-only); the literal window beside, $7.57 to $16.98, fair $6.62 ($5.34 equity-only). No case of the central range earns the floor at the price, so the research pass is written (steps 1 and 2) and closed unrun under Part VII; on the literal window it would run. Facts after the stop: no debt, no goodwill, cash $8.15M; receivables (own customer financing) 29% to 31% of revenue; one customer 33.9% of 2024 revenue and 47.5% of receivables; the 2019 restatement for revenue recognition and internal control not effective for 2020, 2022 and 2023. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; 41 ids, no slip (the analyst's `check_ids.py`); three pathspec commits, own paths only. Lapse declared in the file: the valuation arithmetic was run before Q2 was written; the box does not rest on it. Contamination declared: directory listings showed `Screens/` and root file names and three KSS commit subjects, none opened. Position note filled at the fold: held, 100 shares, the holding review of 2026-10-05 WATCH with NO ADD; this purchase run (an add is a purchase) does not clear an add. No alert (not a gate-clearer).
runs.narr: A blind v5 purchase run on a held name. Q1 IN on a maintenance stream that held through the 2020 closures; Q2 TOO HARD (WORK) on retention: the operator count frozen at 115 since FY2023 against new installs, maintenance flat for six quarters. The blind analyst reached, without seeing it, the same gap the v4.1 row of 2026-08-28 recorded (installed base flat, churn undisclosed). Computation only: range $7.21 to $7.57 all-equity vs $5.37, fair $4.63; the growth convention decides whether the research pass runs. The add stays barred; the WATCH of 2026-10-05 is unchanged by this file.
